scheme_name: Financial assistance for Marriage for the Construction Worker
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of the Union Territory of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
Applicant must be a registered Building/Construction Worker under the Board
Must have engaged in building or other construction work for at least 90 days in a given year
Must have at least six months membership under the Board to apply for the welfare scheme
Alternatively, one of the first two children of a registered member is eligible
benefits_summary: Provides marriage assistance of ₹51,000 for female members and daughters, and ₹35,000 for male members and sons.
